nodes.description: DSAuth.owner: privileged address that passes the auth check.
DSAuth.authority: external DSAuthority contract consulted by isAuthorized.
OSM.wards: mapping(address=>uint) authorization whitelist used by the auth modifier.
OSM.stopped: emergency stop flag consumed by the stoppable modifier.
OSM.src: address of the price source (DSValue) queried by poke.
OSM.hop: time bucket size (default ONE_HOUR) used by prev/pass.
OSM.zzz: timestamp of the last accepted poke, derived from block.timestamp.
OSM.cur: current Feed{val,has} price record.
OSM.nxt: next/staged Feed{val,has} price record.
OSM.bud: mapping(address=>uint) whitelist of contracts allowed through toll.
DSValue.val: stored bytes32 value written by poke.
DSValue.has: validity flag for the stored value.
OSM constructor: sets wards[msg.sender]=1 and src=src_.
rely(address usr) external note auth: grants authorization by writing wards[usr]=1.
deny(address usr) external note auth: revokes authorization by writing wards[usr]=0.
stop() external note auth: sets stopped=1.
start() external note auth: sets stopped=0.
change(address src_) external note auth: replaces the oracle source address.
era() internal view: returns block.timestamp.
prev(uint ts) internal view: rounds ts down to the hop-sized bucket.
step(uint16 ts) external auth: updates the hop bucket size.
void() external note auth: clears cur/nxt and stops the oracle.
pass() public view: returns era() >= add(zzz, hop), the time gate for poke.
poke() external note stoppable: pulls a fresh value from src and rotates cur/nxt/zzz.
peek() external view toll: returns current value and validity.
peep() external view toll: returns next value and validity.
read() external view toll: returns the current value, reverting if cur.has != 1.
kiss(address a) external note auth: whitelists a single contract in bud.
diss(address a) external note auth: removes a single contract from bud.
kiss(address[] a) external note auth: batch whitelist loop over bud.
diss(address[] a) external note auth: batch de-whitelist loop over bud.
DSAuth.setOwner(address owner_) public auth: rewrites owner.
DSAuth.setAuthority(DSAuthority authority_) public auth: rewrites authority.
DSAuth.isAuthorized: compares src to address(this)/owner and otherwise delegates to authority.canCall.
OSM.add(uint64 x, uint64 y): unchecked-style addition with require(z >= x).
DSMath.sub(uint x, uint y): subtraction guarded by require((z = x - y) <= x).
DSMath.mul(uint x, uint y): multiplication guarded by require(y == 0 || (z = x*y)/y == x).
DSValue.poke(bytes32 wut) public note auth: writes val and sets has = true.
DSValue.void() public note auth: sets has = false.
LibNote.note modifier: emits an anonymous log4 via inline assembly after the wrapped call.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, whitelisting and logging.
Miner-influenceable time source consumed by era()/prev()/pass()/poke().
Privileged state write wards[usr] = 1 / wards[usr] = 0.
Whitelist grant bud[a] = 1 enabling toll-gated readers.
Whitelist revocation bud[a] = 0.
External call DSValue(src).peek() inside poke() before state rotation.
Inline assembly log4 that copies calldata and reads caller()/msg.sig.
uint64 addition z = x + y with a post-hoc overflow require.
State mutation cur = nxt; nxt = Feed(...); zzz = prev(era()) executed after the external call.
Auth-gated write val = wut; has = true in DSValue.
owner = msg.sender assignment in the DSAuth constructor.
Address argument of rely/deny used as the wards mapping key.
Constructor / change() argument written into the src state variable.
Argument of step(uint16 ts) written into hop.
bytes32 argument of DSValue.poke written into val.
Address argument of kiss/diss used as the bud mapping key.
Left operand of add/sub/mul.
Right operand of add/sub/mul.
Argument of setOwner written into owner.
Argument of setAuthority written into authority.
Return/accumulator variable of the arithmetic helpers (z = x + y, etc.).
Local bytes32 wut holding the value returned by DSValue(src).peek().
Local bool ok returned by DSValue(src).peek(), gating the poke branch.
Loop index used by the batched kiss/diss whitelist loops.

edges.reason: DSAuth constructor assigns owner from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
owner write is driven by msg.sender, making the caller the initial privileged account.
wards is keyed and read with msg.sender in the constructor, rely, deny and the auth modifier.
bud whitelist lookups use msg.sender in the toll modifier.
rely is reachable only when wards[msg.sender] == 1 through auth.
deny is reachable only when wards[msg.sender] == 1 through auth.
stop is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
start is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
change is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
step is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
void is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
kiss(address) is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
diss(address) is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
kiss(address[]) is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
diss(address[]) is gated by the auth modifier on msg.sender.
setOwner is auth-gated and can transfer the privileged owner role.
isAuthorized receives msg.sender as src and compares it against owner / address(this).
DSValue.void is gated by the auth modifier on the calling address.
peek is gated by the toll modifier checking bud[msg.sender].
peep is gated by the toll modifier checking bud[msg.sender].
read is gated by the toll modifier checking bud[msg.sender].
Privileged wards write is only reachable by an authorized msg.sender.
Whitelist grant is only reachable by an authorized msg.sender.
Whitelist revocation is only reachable by an authorized msg.sender.
caller() is packed into the anonymous log4 payload in the note modifier.
era() returns block.timestamp directly.
prev() derives the hop bucket from the current timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
pass() compares era() against zzz + hop, so availability of poke depends on time.
poke requires pass() and stores prev(era()), making the oracle update time dependent.
zzz is written from block.timestamp via prev(era()).
Timestamp-derived zzz is combined with hop through the uint64 addition.
poke makes an external call to src (DSValue.peek) before updating its own state.
cur/nxt/zzz are mutated after the external call, violating checks-effects-interactions.
poke performs the cur/nxt/zzz state rotation as its core effect.
poke assigns cur = nxt.
poke writes the new Feed into nxt.
setOwner rewrites the owner state variable.
setAuthority rewrites the authority state variable.
isAuthorized falls back to authority.canCall for unknown callers.
isAuthorized returns true when src equals owner.
rely writes wards[usr] = 1.
deny writes wards[usr] = 0.
kiss(address) writes bud[a] = 1.
diss(address) writes bud[a] = 0.
kiss(address[]) loops writing bud[a[i]] = 1.
diss(address[]) loops writing bud[a[i]] = 0.
The usr parameter is used as the key of the privileged wards write.
usr is the rely() argument whose authorization is granted.
usr is the deny() argument whose authorization is revoked.
The a parameter is used as the key of the bud whitelist grant.
a is the kiss(address) argument checked against address(0) and whitelisted.
src_ is written into src, redirecting the trusted oracle source.
src_ is the change() argument that repoints the price source.
ts is written into hop, changing the time bucket size.
ts is the step() argument validated with a non-zero require.
wut is stored into DSValue.val.
wut is the value assigned by val = wut inside DSValue.poke.
x is the left operand of the uint64 addition.
y is the right operand of the uint64 addition.
x is the add() parameter.
y is the add() parameter.
owner_ is assigned to the owner state variable in setOwner.
authority_ is assigned to the authority state variable in setAuthority.
z is the addition result validated by require(z >= x).
z is the return variable of add().
The value read from the oracle flows into cur.
The value read from the oracle flows into Feed(uint128(wut), 1) stored in nxt.
The ok flag returned by peek gates the state rotation branch inside poke.
Loop index i drives each bud[a[i]] = 1 write in the batched kiss.
pass() consumes the uint64 addition result as the time threshold.
poke reverts unless pass() returns true.
peek() reads cur.val and cur.has.
peep() reads nxt.val and nxt.has.
read() requires cur.has == 1 and returns cur.val.
poke evaluates the time gate through era().
poke buckets the current time using prev().
The constructor seeds wards[msg.sender] = 1 for the deployer.
The constructor stores the provided src_ into src.
DSValue.poke performs the val/has write.
The note modifier emits the inline-assembly log4 entry.
DSValue.poke sets has = true after writing val.
DSValue.void clears has = false.

normalization_plan.reason: The usr parameter only exists to key the privileged wards state write and can be folded into that unsafe operation.
The src_ parameter only feeds the change() oracle-repointing function and can be absorbed there.
The ts parameter is used solely by step() to set hop.
The wut parameter only feeds DSValue.poke's val write.
The a parameter is only used to index the bud whitelist grant.
The x parameter exists only as an operand of the add helper.
The y parameter exists only as an operand of the add helper.
The owner_ parameter is only consumed by setOwner.
The authority_ parameter is only consumed by setAuthority.
The local z is the return accumulator of add and adds no independent semantics.
The local wut only carries the oracle return value inside poke.
The local ok only gates the poke branch after the external call.
The loop index i is an implementation detail of the batched kiss whitelist loop.
